label: Value per activated customer
note: Contribution in the first 12 months after activation, not revenue recognised in the next 12 months.
short: ARQ press figures; Nu México revenue and margin
basis: Low: ARQ's reported US$10bn volume ÷ 2m users × 0.5% fee = $25 revenue a year, less $12 cost to serve (Nu México, $1 a month). Mid: Nu México ARPAC $12.50 × 12 × 40% first-year ramp (assumption) × 35.3% gross margin. High: the same without the ramp, an average Nu México customer. Not all reported volume carries the fee, and users are not all active.

label: Activation rate after approval
note: Approved records that become active customers; approval is not account enablement.
short: Liftoff LATAM and fintech activation; Nu activity rate
basis: Low: Liftoff LATAM activation rate 38.2%. Mid: Liftoff fintech activation rate 56.3% (2021–22 data; the source doesn't define activation). High: Nu's monthly activity rate of 83%, a ceiling set by a mature primary bank. None measures approved-to-active directly.

label: Share of applicants from paid channels
note: Only paid applicants carry acquisition cost; organic declines are not wasted spend.
basis: Low: 29% of Nu's new Brazilian customers in 2025 were not sourced organically. High: Nu acquired more than 50% of Mexican customers through referrals, so other channels are under 50%. Mid: 40% (assumption). Not every non-organic channel is paid.

label: Acquisition cost per paid applicant
note: Spend per paid applicant who reached KYC.
short: Liftoff cost per install and per registration
basis: Low: Liftoff LATAM cost per install $1.60 ÷ 18.3% registration rate = $8.74 per registration. Mid: Liftoff fintech cost per registration $17.96. High: $17.96 ÷ 60% of registrants reaching KYC (assumption). 2021–22 data.

label: Billable vendor transactions per decision
note: One recorded decision may involve several or no billable transactions.
short: Assumption; replace with invoiced transactions ÷ decisions
basis: Low: one billable transaction per decision. Mid and high: 1.2 and 1.5 with retries (assumption). Some vendors (Sumsub) charge only for successful verifications, which would make not-approved decisions free.

label: Vendor cost per billable transaction
short: Veriff and Sumsub list prices; Vendr estimate for Jumio
basis: Low: Veriff Essential $0.80 + PEP and sanctions $0.64. Mid: Sumsub Compliance $1.85, which includes AML screening. High: top of Vendr's $1.50–$3.00 estimate for Jumio at 100,000–500,000 verifications a year; the extract annualises to about 316,790 decisions. Self-serve list prices; negotiated enterprise rates are usually lower.

label: Cost per manual review
basis: Monthly gross salary × loaded factor ÷ MXN 18.3528 ÷ 140 productive hours × minutes per case × quality uplift. Low: MXN 11,236 (Paylab, lowest 10% of financial analysts) × 1.3, 8 min, ×1.1. Mid: MXN 39,608 (TalentUp KYC analyst median) × 1.35, 15 min, ×1.1. High: the same salary × 1.4, 25 min, ×1.2. Hours, minutes and uplift are assumptions.

label: Implementation cost of the recurring-cause actions
note: Engineering, design and vendor work for the actions behind the recoverable approvals.
basis: Engineer-weeks × loaded weekly cost × team overhead. Weeks: 12 / 13 / 19.5, from the roadmap's effort for the four 30-day actions plus 2 weeks of review tooling; high adds a 50% overrun. Weekly cost: Levels.fyi median MX$1,146,490 ÷ 18.3528 × 1.3 or × 1.35 ÷ 52 ($1,562, $1,622); high uses Revelo's top fully loaded $126,000 ($2,423). Overhead for product, design, QA and vendor work: ×1.3 / ×1.5 / ×1.8 (assumption).

label: Run cost per month
note: Extra checks, retries, review and support.
short: Review cases and retake vendor calls, central scenario
basis: Central scenario, per 30 days: 278 review-pilot cases × cost per review, plus about 191 guided selfie retakes × billable transactions × cost per transaction, using the same preset's values. Excludes support contacts and monitoring tools.
